title: Smart Routing
description: Smart Routing allows you to redirect users to different destinations based on their device, location, time, or language.

sections.title: How it works
sections.content: When a user scans a Smart Routing QR code, QRise evaluates a list of rules from top to bottom. The first rule that matches the user's scan context (device, location, etc.) determines the destination. If no rules match, the user is sent to the default URL.

sections.title: Rule evaluation
items: Rules are evaluated in order of priority (lowest number first)
If multiple conditions exist in a rule, ALL must match (AND logic)
If no rule matches, the default destination is used
